title: Scammers Reportedly Using Deepfakes of Health Experts and Public Figures in Australia to Sell Health Supplements and Give Harmful Advice

behaviors.text: Scammers are reportedly harnessing AI-generated deepfakes of health experts and [person] figures in Australia in order to sell health supplements and give harmful health advice.

Among the reported cases, deepfake videos are alleged to have falsely depicted [person] and [person] endorsing "Glyco Balance" for diabetes management, while [person] reportedly was falsely shown promoting blood pressure pills.
